# Best Practices for Dosing Systems: lessons from the field (summary)

Dorrit Marqdale, an expert in hydroponic nutrient delivery, presented key recommendations for optimizing dosing systems in vertical farming, focusing on accuracy, consistency, and responsiveness to enhance crop yield and quality. She highlighted several practical lessons from VerdantGrow Labs, including the importance of frequent calibration, effective nutrient mixing, system redundancy, and the integration of real-time sensor data with AI forecasting. Dorrit emphasized that these strategies have supported the successful scale-up of grow towers from pilot to commercial operations, improving both nutrient delivery precision and resource efficiency.

- Dosing pumps should maintain flow rate stability within ±2% over 24 hours to prevent nutrient imbalances.
- Nutrient reservoirs require continuous low-speed agitation to avoid stratification and ensure homogeneous dosing.
- EC and pH sensors need recalibration every 72 hours during active growth phases for accurate monitoring.
- Dual dosing lines with automatic failover add redundancy, reducing risks of crop loss despite a roughly 18% increase in system costs.
- Integration of AI-driven forecasting with real-time sensor data enables quicker dosing adjustments, cutting nutrient response latency to under 5 minutes and improving resource efficiency by 15%.
